title: The Platinum Mod
description: This mod adds Platinum to Minecraft! Now you can upgrade Netherite to Platinum!!
body:
**The Platinum Mod** introduces a new endgame tier designed for players who’ve mastered Netherite and are ready to push their gear further. Platinum Ore generates naturally in the End, appearing both on the main island and outer islands, giving players multiple opportunities to gather this rare resource. Once mined, the ore is smelted into Platinum Ingots, forming the foundation of this powerful upgrade system.

To transform Netherite equipment into Platinum, players need the special Platinum Upgrade Template, ensuring that the progression feels deliberate and rewarding. This system keeps the journey from Netherite to Platinum structured, giving a meaningful challenge without breaking the vanilla gameplay flow.

Platinum tools and armor boast higher durability and enhanced stats, perfect for late-game survival, End exploration, or taking on dangerous mobs. Every piece is carefully balanced to feel like a true upgrade, providing power without overpowering.

For builders, Platinum Blocks offer a sleek, metallic aesthetic, ideal for modern bases, End-themed structures, or display-worthy creations. With this mod, players gain a polished, lore-friendly, and fully integrated post-Netherite progression that gives the End new purpose and excitement.
